target_customer: Consumers in Latin America and emerging markets who want dollar balances, remittances and spending via stablecoins
problem: People in high inflation countries such as Venezuela struggle to hold stable money and send or receive remittances cheaply.
business_model: Consumer fintech app earning on transfers, conversions and card or account services

founders.name: Kevin Charles
founders.background_notes: Listed on the YC page; founder profile details not on the page.

founders.name: Victor Charles
founders.background_notes: YC profile: Venezuelan building and shipping crypto products since 2014.

technical_complexity.rationale: A mobile wallet with fiat on and off ramps in volatile markets needs payments integrations and compliance; the 2019 version was a marketplace and remittance prototype.

defensibility.rationale: Remittance and wallet apps are widely copied; local ramps and trust may help but no structural moat is shown.

market_need_then: Venezuelan migration and crypto remittance growth created demand to send money home, per press on Venezuela crypto remittances in later years; no source dated 2019 was opened.

branding.domain_note: Uses cocowallet.app; the earlier product was called Coco Pago per search coverage.

identity.voice_and_tone: Spanish language, simple message of a global digital wallet without borders

brand_strength.rationale: Friendly short name but no brand press or community evidence found, and it is easily confused with other coco and coca crypto products.

outcome_analysis: Coco Wallet entered YC in Summer 2019 from a Venezuelan crypto founder team and has evolved from a marketplace and remittance idea into a stablecoin dollar account with a team of about 50. It remains active, but no reliable funding history or outcome data was found in public sources, so its trajectory cannot be judged beyond survival and product breadth.
notes: Unverified funding: Caplight lists a crowdfunding round in 2024-01 of about 669K dollars and the founder is reported to claim 2M dollars raised, both from single aggregator or profile sources, so no round is recorded. A search snippet mentions an earlier marketplace product called Coco Mercado and a seed raise target of 1.5M, from one profile only. Start year 2018 versus 2019 is disputed. No competitor source dated near 2019 was found; current competitor commentary is from 2025 or later and not used.
